description_en: Queries the cross-account authorization list of Express Connect Router (ECR) for a VBR
description_zh: 查询VBR的专线网关跨账号授权列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-grant-rules-to-ecr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id vbr-xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGrantRulesToEcr

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the VBR belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You must specify at least 1 tag key and can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。至少输入1个标签键，最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

EcrGrantRules.description_en: The cross-account authorization list of Express Connect Router (ECR)
EcrGrantRules.description_zh: 专线网关跨账号授权列表

CreateTime.description_en: The authorization time. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 授权时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

EcrInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the cross-account authorization for the Express Connect Router (ECR)
EcrInstanceId.description_zh: 专线网关跨账号授权实例ID

EcrUid.description_en: The authorized user ID for the cross-account authorization of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
EcrUid.description_zh: 专线网关跨账号授权用户ID

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
